description: For window cleaning, this request form records scheduled interior and exterior work, recurring exclusions, stain treatment, ladder limits, crew, and approved add-ons. Its supporting evidence includes pane completion counts, condition changes, screen tracking, weather, access exceptions, photos, and quality recheck.
